<!--
Thank you for taking the time to submit a methodology observation.

This template helps make your feedback structured and easy to triage. Please
fill in as many fields as Apply; fields marked "optional" can be left blank
if you don't have a view, and the "Status" row is filled in by the maintainer.

If you're not sure how to fill in a field, leave a placeholder and ask in
the issue comments. Partial information is better than none.
-->

| Field | Your answer |
|---|---|
| **Date** | <!-- e.g. 2026-05-15 --> |
| **Framework** | FLOW |
| **LLM** | <!-- e.g. Claude Sonnet 4.6, Mistral Large 2 --> |
| **Temperature** | <!-- e.g. Unmodified, 0.0, 0.5, 1.0, etc. --> |
| **Project type** | <!-- e.g. academic essay, blog post, research paper, fiction, technical writing --> |
| **FLOW estimated prompt tokens** | <!-- As disclosed at the bottom of the FLOW Report --> |
| **FLOW pillar(s) affected** | <!-- one or more of: Find / Lead / Organize / Write --> |
| **Severity** | <!-- one of: one-off oddity / systematic pattern / structural issue --> |
| **Expected outcome** | <!-- what FLOW *should* have produced, in your view --> |
| **Actual outcome** | <!-- what FLOW *did* produce --> |
| **Possible cause** *(optional)* | <!-- your hypothesis, if any --> |
| **Suggested solution** *(optional)* | <!-- your proposed fix, if any --> |
| **Initials** | <!-- for attribution --> |
| **Contact** | <!-- email or GitHub handle for follow-up --> |
| **Status** | *(leave blank — filled in by the maintainer)* |

## Additional context

<!--
Add any further context here — links to the FLOW report or shared
artifact (if it's appropriate to share), screenshots, related issues,
or anything else that would help the maintainer understand the
observation.

If the observation involves a specific FLOW report you generated,
please indicate whether you're comfortable sharing the report's
content (or a redacted version) for review. Methodology debugging
often benefits from concrete examples.
-->

## Checklist before submitting

- [ ] I have searched existing issues for similar observations
- [ ] I have indicated which FLOW pillar(s) my observation relates to
- [ ] I have distinguished between expected and actual outcomes
- [ ] I have redacted any sensitive information from screenshots and logs where appropriate
- [ ] I understand that methodology changes are reviewed conservatively (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md #methodology-contributions))
